properties.description: Verifies a VM can be successfully provisioned and booted from the image under test within the expected time window. Validated by provisioning a VM from the image and confirming it boots. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.18. More info: https://aka.ms/VM-Provisioning-Issue.

Verifies each data disk VHD size is within the allowed range (must be less than 8 TB). Validated by reading the disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.17. More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/partner-center/marketplace-offers/azure-vm-certification-faq#data-disk-size-verification.

Verifies the VHD size is an exact multiple of 1 MB for the OS disk and every provided data disk, as required by the VHD specification. Validated by reading each disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.13. More info: https://aka.ms/vhd-specifications.
properties.displayName: OS Disk Size Multiple of 1 MB Check

properties.description: Verifies the OS disk VHD size is within the allowed range (limits differ by OS family). Validated by reading the disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.12. More info: https://aka.ms/os-disk-size-validation.

Verifies the first 1 MB of the OS disk VHD is reserved and free (offset), as required by the VHD specification. Validated by reading the disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.4. More info: https://aka.ms/First-1MB-Offset.

Verifies the VHD footer is well-formed for the OS disk and every provided data disk (the footer cookie is set correctly per the VHD specification). Validated by reading each disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.11. More info: https://aka.ms/vhd-specifications.

Linux Quality Validation Suite backed by LISA (Linux Integration Services Automation). This single leaf runs the set of Linux quality tests the caller selects at run time via the inputs below; the individual checks are not modelled as separate leaves. The image, placement, and identity context comes from the Execution Plan and is not redeclared here. Validated by provisioning a Linux VM from the image and running the selected tests. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.3.8. More info: https://aka.ms/Linux-Testcases and https://github.com/microsoft/lisa.

definition.description: Maximum number of Linux quality tests to run in parallel.

The Linux quality test selection to run. Each entry selects tests by name/area/category/tag/priority; the service runs the resolved union. The concrete tests to execute are listed in testNames (e.g. 'smoke_test', 'verify_dns_name_resolution').

properties.description: Scans the image for malware using Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Validated by reading the disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. More info: https://aka.ms/Certification-Malware-Found.
properties.displayName: Malware Scan by Microsoft Defender for Cloud

properties.description: Scans the image for malware using the ESRP scanning engine. Validated by reading the disk VHD directly; no VM is provisioned. More info: https://aka.ms/Certification-Malware-Found.
Scans a provisioned VM with Microsoft Defender for Cloud for known vulnerabilities. The validation fails when one or more vulnerabilities meet or exceed the configured CVSSv3 failure threshold.

definition.description: CVSSv3 score triggering validation failure. Allowed values are 0 through 10. If omitted, AzCertify uses its service default of 8.5.

properties.description: Verifies the Active Directory Rights Management Services (AD RMS) role is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the AD RMS roles (ADRMS/RSAT-ADRMS/RSAT-RMS) are not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.12. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Azure Windows Guest Agent installed on the image meets the minimum required version. Validated by provisioning a VM and reading the installed Azure Guest Agent version from the registry, which must be at least 2.7.41491.911. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.14. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies BitLocker Drive Encryption is not enabled on the operating system disk of the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm BitLocker is not enabled on the OS disk (it may still be used on data disks). Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.2. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (and related ATP/Defender) onboarding artifacts are not pre-installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and confirming no Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarding artifacts are present. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.4.2. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the DHCP Server role is not installed on the image under test (not supported by Azure). Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the DHCP Server role is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.3. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Windows Server Failover Clustering feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the Failover Clustering feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.4. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Internet Storage Name Server (iSNS) feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the iSNS feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.6. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Multipath I/O (MPIO) feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the Multipath-IO feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.8. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Network Load Balancing (NLB) feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the Network Load Balancing feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.9. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the image's actual OS architecture matches the declared architecture (x64 or Arm64). Validated by provisioning a VM and reading the reported OS architecture (via Win32_OperatingSystem), which must be 64-bit or ARM 64-bit. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.2. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Peer Name Resolution Protocol (PNRP) feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the PNRP feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.13. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Remote Access (DirectAccess/VPN) server role is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the Remote Access roles (RemoteAccess/DirectAccess-VPN/DAMC) are not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.11. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the SNMP Service feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the SNMP Service feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.10. Verifies the image does not contain unlicensed software that would violate Azure software-compliance requirements. Validated by provisioning a VM and enumerating installed programs from the registry uninstall keys to confirm no unlicensed software is present. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.1. More info: https://aka.ms/Software-compliance-For-Windows.

Verifies the test provider (AzCertify) can sign in to and run its PowerShell validation checks on a VM created from the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and confirming remote sign-in and command execution succeed. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.17. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies that a VM extension can be provisioned and executed successfully on a VM created from the image. Validated by provisioning a VM, installing the Azure Custom Script Extension (used to enable WinRM on Windows), and confirming the extension reaches a Succeeded provisioning state. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.1.15. More info: https://aka.ms/VM-Extension.

Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the WINS roles (WINS/RSAT-WINS) are not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.14. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Verifies the Wireless LAN Service feature is not installed on the image under test. Validated by provisioning a VM and running Get-WindowsFeature to confirm the Wireless-Networking feature is not installed. Applies to Windows Server images only; AzCertify detects the image type from the OS name and skips this check for client images. AzCertify PolicyId: 200.3.2.15. More info: https://aka.ms/Windows-testcases.

Root taxonomy node for AzCertify image-certification validation suites. Leaf categories under this root group the individual certification checks a publisher's image runs through (basic VM, image file integrity, malware, vulnerability, and OS/quality validations).
AzCertify basic VM validations that provision a VM from the image under test and confirm it boots and provisions within the expected window (e.g. the VM boot / provisioning check).
AzCertify image file integrity validations that inspect the image disk itself (e.g. OS-disk size limits, data-disk size limits, VHD footer and first-1MB alignment, disk-size multiple-of-1MB checks).

AzCertify Linux image-quality validations (AITL). This is the one AzCertify family with per-run inputs: a single leaf fans out to many AITL tests, and the caller selects which AITL test names to run via the leaf's inputs.

AzCertify malware validations that scan the image VHD for malware. AzCertify selects the scan engine internally (e.g. Defender or ESRP); the VHD to scan comes from the run's shared certificationPackageReference.
AzCertify vulnerability validations that provision a VM from the image under test and use Microsoft Defender for Cloud to identify vulnerabilities that exceed the configured CVSSv3 failure threshold.

AzCertify Windows image-quality validations (e.g. OS architecture matches the declared architectureType, disallowed server roles/features not installed, agent/extension provisioning, BitLocker and Defender posture, VM connectivity).
Root category for AzQualify Azure host/fabric platform validation covering host agents, VM deployment, host lifecycle operations, reliability, baselines, and blade monitoring.

Root category for AzQualify networking-subsystem validation covering network datapath, SDN, VNet encryption, core networking, guest RDMA, Overlake networking, DP host plugin, and networking performance scenarios.
AzQualify baseline and control-group reference tests that establish a known-good host platform baseline, including smoke tests.
AzQualify Overlake-specific networking tests (Overlake ControlGroup networking variant).
Root category for AzQualify database validation covering SQL Managed Instance, Teradata, and database performance scenarios.
AzQualify database performance tests covering ControlGroup SQL and SQL TPCE workload scenarios.
AzQualify host-side agent tests covering HostAgent, IGVM, MANA, SoC, Repair, and Coalesced agents.
Root category for AzQualify hardware validation covering hardware qualification and driver verification scenarios.
AzQualify hardware qualification tests covering HW SKU qualification and hardware scenario validation.
AzQualify networking performance tests covering NetworkPerf and N1WS performance scenarios.
AzQualify VNet encryption tests covering N1WS-perf encryption, control-group encryption, and encryption scale scenarios.
Root category for AzQualify live-migration validation suites covering LM agents, in-place migration, NVAICS, and Overlake PMEM live-migration performance scenarios.
AzQualify live-migration tests covering NVAICS LM, LM agents, in-place migration, and live migration scenarios.
Root category for AzQualify operating-system validation suites covering host OS servicing, ephemeral OS, Glibc, and Windows Server OS scenarios.
AzQualify operating-system tests covering host OS, ephemeral OS, OS servicing, Glibc, SoC OS, OS update, and Windows Server 2025 scenarios.
AzQualify VM and infrastructure deployment tests covering ASAP, ARM template, TiP-dynamic, and VM deployment scenarios.
